svg.title: ILO-unemployed and category A registrants in France, 2024
svg.desc: Bar in three segments: 863,000 ILO-unemployed not registered in category A, 1.43 million people in both at once, 1.47 million category A registrants who are not ILO-unemployed (Insee estimate, 2024).
svg.text: ILO-unemployed and category A registrants in France, 2024
two definitions, populations that partly overlap (thousands of people)
Registered in category A at France Travail: 2,893
of whom: not registered 524; registered in B or C 240;
inactive outside the halo 503; in work 236
Insee Références, Emploi, chômage, revenus du travail, 2026 ed., file 1, figures 2 and 8 (Dares-Insee-France Travail matching)
Insee estimate, 2024 average, France excluding Mayotte, aged 15-64, ordinary housing; two distinct definitions.
